subject.title: fix(agents): keep bundle LSP tool names provider-safe

question: Should bundled LSP tool-name compatibility guarantee only already-valid complete names, allowing unsafe, overlong, and colliding generated names to be deterministically repaired as this PR does?
rationale: The code can enforce either policy, but source and tests cannot decide whether previously exposed generated identifiers—despite being invalid or ambiguous on stricter providers—are a supported user policy contract.

options.title: Accept bounded repair
options.body: Preserve already-valid complete names and allow deterministic normalization only where the old name is unsafe, overlong, or colliding.

options.title: Require a broader stable mapping
options.body: Pause merge until maintainers define and document a permanent generated-name mapping or migration contract for every prior server key.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded repair
recommendation.body: Preserve already-valid complete names and allow deterministic normalization only where the old name is unsafe, overlong, or colliding.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-provider agent-runtime compatibility choice rather than a remaining mechanical defect, and prior review routing identified steipete for that decision.
